_about: How each recorded line is performed: ElevenLabs audio tags, sent to the voice (tools/audio/generate.mjs) when the speaker's model performs them (Eleven v3, v4 and later). Keyed by speaker, then by the line's exact text as the game shows it. An entry is either tags that go in front of the line (usually one, at most two, chosen from the line's scene and mood, and never fighting the words), or a whole performance: the line's exact text with up to five tags at its turns, starting with one, which may describe the voice itself (Captain Jumble's lines). Take a performance's tags out and even its spaces, and it must read exactly as the line. Tags are never shown, never part of a manifest key and never change a file name. A new or changed line isn't done until it has its direction; test/audio.test.js checks.
